description: Regression questions for the Northstar Digital handbook (evaluation/datasets/northstar/). Documents 01-04 are a reconstruction from the facts listed in the 2026-09-28 manual test report, not the original files; 05-07 were added for the larger set, and 06 (travel FAQ) deliberately conflicts with 05 (meal allowance, claim deadline). Questions 1-8 are the report's tests; the rest were written before the system was run on them. expected_behavior: answer | yes | reject_premise | not_specified | abstain | conflict. required_facts are lower-case substrings the final answer must contain.
